Master–detail, no page changes: cabinet left (5 of 12 cols), the newest item
open on the right so the big area is the work, not empty.
Tapping a drawer replaces the right side with the drawer (sheets as a 3-up
thumbnail grid, other kinds as rows).
The scrubber spans the full width; detents are rounds and locks only (8),
never one per decision (45 in ~30 h would put ticks 7 px apart on a phone).
Tablet uses this layout from 768 px.
